column2: [4] Dragon Isle
A volcanic island in the middle of a lava lake called "Dragon Island" was recently lost to the Arachnids. With the arrival of Zhao's M.I. detachment, the time has come to take it back.
Clear all Hives
Activate all Pumping Stations
Do not lose more than 1 Pumping Station
Clear the mountain Hive
Guide sedated Bugs to the Cargo Ship
Do not lose the Pheromone Carrier
Keep at least 5 sedated Bugs alive
Deploy Shredders to counter Pyroflies

Clear out these Bugs. The Federation needs these fuel supplies secured!
Doing good, Fed. Maybe there's a job here for you with us.
The Mobile Infantry gives me something you'll never have.
'Service guarantees citizenship'? Please! Good luck retiring on all those citizenship bucks...if you retire at all…
Another area cleared!
Excellent work, captain. The Mobile Infantry are living up to their reputation.
Deploying onto Dragon Island. What's our orders?
Our facilities there were overrun by Arachnids some time ago. It's vital we clear out the Bugs and restart fuel production immediately.
Sounds like a HephaeStar operation. Why are we here?
The Sky Marshal understands the importance of what we are doing here, Captain.  And he appreciates your efforts.
You keep the Bugs busy, Fed Man. Me and my people will restart those pumps.
Understood. Moving out.
Fraser? I'm talking to you now on a private side-channel.
Got another Bug-collecting job?
I'll let you know when the client's ready to receive the merchandise.
Another pump online. I can feel that bonus money flowing into my off-world account!
Third pump re-activated. The richer I get, the more patriotic I feel.
Last one done. One step closer to early retirement!
There's the pumping stations. I need you to switch them back on.
Juice has gotta flow, huh?  And..?
And there'll be a healthy bonus for every one you get back online.
All I needed to hear!
Well done, captain! The Dragon Island facility is back in our hands. I'm already sending a commendation for you to the Sky Marshal's office.
Thank you, ma'am. We're just here to do our duty.
Return to the station for rest and debriefing.
Mister Fraser, take defensive overwatch until the captain's people are safely away.
Got it.
Mister Fraser...
Bug-collecting time, now that the choirboy's gone?
There's suitable specimens in the small mountain hive. Sending you the location now.
Risky work, this. Maybe we need to re-negotiate our deal...
Don't get greedy. You're not the only force at my disposal now.
The M.I? You want them to know what you're doing with the Bugs?
Yeah, I didn't think so.
Cargo delivered. Need to keep 'em better contained this time. Lucky for us, choirboy was there last time to clean up that mess.
Got 'em. Where you want 'em?
The client's sent a ship to take delivery of them.
Shredders will take care of them. Let's get on with our objectives.
Some new kind of Bug!
We call 'em Pyroflies. Nasty sons of bitches, ain't they? No worries, Fed. We got the weapons and know-how to deal with them...
